scripts.test: npm run test:schedule && npm run test:schema
scripts.test:schedule: tsc src/lib/schedule.ts src/lib/submission.ts src/types.ts --outDir .test-build --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --strict && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > .test-build/package.json && node tests/test-schedule.cjs && node tests/test-submission.cjs
scripts.test:schema: node tests/test-schema.mjs && node tests/test-flow.mjs && node tests/test-trust.mjs && node tests/test-private.mjs
